note: Model output on real document sets, kept for human review. Not a score.

sets.name: Licence agreement
sets.engagement: Intellectual property licensing due diligence for a joint content license agreement between WPT Enterprises and Zynga entities.

items.name: Intellectual property schedule
items.what_it_is: List of patents, trademarks, copyrights, and domain names licensed under the agreement, including registration numbers and jurisdictions.
items.why_needed: To confirm the scope of licensed IP and identify any gaps or encumbrances.

sets.name: Franchise agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of a potential franchise acquisition (purchase of franchise rights and associated business).

items.name: Audited Financial Statements (Franchisee)
items.what_it_is: Balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, and notes audited by an independent CPA.
items.why_needed: To assess the financial health and profitability of the franchise business being acquired.

items.name: Operations Manual
items.what_it_is: Document detailing standards, procedures, and requirements for operating the franchise.
items.why_needed: To verify compliance requirements and operational controls imposed by the franchisor.

items.name: Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD)
items.what_it_is: Legal disclosure document containing Items 1‑23 required by the FTC Franchise Rule.
items.why_needed: To verify all material facts about the franchise offering and any restrictions.

items.name: Current Franchisee List
items.what_it_is: List of all active franchisees with contact information and store locations.
items.why_needed: To assess franchisee satisfaction, performance, and potential hidden issues.

items.name: Insurance Certificates
items.what_it_is: Proof of general liability, property, workers' compensation, and any required franchise-specific coverage.
items.why_needed: To ensure adequate risk transfer and compliance with franchisor insurance requirements.

items.name: Royalty and Fee Payment Records
items.what_it_is: Ledger or statements showing payments of royalties, advertising fund contributions, and other fees to franchisor.
items.why_needed: To verify that the franchisee is current on obligations and to assess cash flow impact.
items.note: The model runs disagreed on whether this was supplied. Check it.

sets.name: Endorsement agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of a material endorsement agreement for SEC filing disclosure

items.name: Board resolution
items.what_it_is: Formal approval by Adams Golf’s board authorizing the endorsement agreement.
items.why_needed: Validate authority to bind the corporation under the agreement.

items.name: Trademark registrations
items.what_it_is: USPTO registrations for Adams Golf product lines referenced in the agreement.
items.why_needed: Confirm that the licensed products are properly protected IP.

sets.name: Services agreement
sets.engagement: Due diligence review of a services agreement between Provider and Recipients.

items.name: Services Agreement
items.what_it_is: The primary contract governing services between Provider and Recipients.
items.why_needed: Baseline for assessing rights, obligations, and risk exposure.

items.name: Service performance reports / SLA compliance
items.what_it_is: Reports measuring provider’s performance against agreed service levels.
items.why_needed: To evaluate whether services meet contractual standards.

items.name: Invoice and payment records
items.what_it_is: Billing statements and proof of payments exchanged under the agreement.
items.why_needed: To assess financial compliance and any outstanding amounts.

items.name: Board resolutions or corporate authorizations
items.what_it_is: Internal approvals by each party’s board or authorized signatories to enter the agreement.
items.why_needed: To confirm proper authority and enforceability.

items.name: Amendments or side letters
items.what_it_is: Written modifications to the original agreement after effective date.
items.why_needed: To capture any changes affecting obligations or fees.

items.name: Insurance Certificates (Professional Liability/Cyber)
items.what_it_is: Proof of insurance coverage held by Provider for service-related risks.
items.why_needed: Confirms ability to cover potential claims.

sets.name: SEC enforcement order
sets.engagement: SEC administrative proceeding review of Latch, Inc.'s settlement and remedial actions regarding revenue recognition violations.

items.name: Offer of Settlement
items.what_it_is: The respondent's settlement offer submitted to the SEC.
items.why_needed: To assess terms of agreement and adequacy of remedial commitments.

items.name: Auditor’s Report on Restated Financials
items.what_it_is: Independent auditor’s opinion on the company’s restated financial statements.
items.why_needed: To verify that the restatement conforms with GAAP and SEC requirements.

items.name: SEC‑Latch Correspondence
items.what_it_is: Letters, emails, and meeting minutes between Latch and the SEC concerning the settlement.
items.why_needed: To evaluate negotiation dynamics and any concessions made.

sets.name: Annual report (10-K)
sets.engagement: Financial due diligence and valuation of United Parcel Service, Inc. based on its 2020 Form 10-K.

items.name: Latest quarterly Form 10-Q (Q1 2021)
items.what_it_is: Quarterly financial statements and MD&A for the period ended March 31, 2021.
items.why_needed: To assess post‑year‑end performance trends and updated financial position beyond the 2020 annual data.

items.name: Definitive Proxy Statement (DEF 14A) for 2021
items.what_it_is: Shareholder meeting materials containing detailed executive compensation, director independence, and related‑party transactions.
items.why_needed: Compensation and governance details are only summarized in the 10‑K; full proxy needed for thorough diligence.

items.name: Debt covenant compliance certificates
items.what_it_is: Reports from the trustee or lender confirming adherence to financial covenants in UPS’s senior note indentures.
items.why_needed: While Note 9 outlines debt, diligence requires verification that covenants are met post‑2020.

items.name: Internal Control over Financial Reporting (SOX 404) auditor’s attestation
items.what_it_is: The auditor’s report on the effectiveness of UPS’s internal control over financial reporting for FY 2020.
items.why_needed: Item 9A mentions controls and procedures but does not include the auditor’s attestation needed for reliance on financials.

sets.name: Earnings release
sets.engagement: Financial due diligence review of Franklin Covey’s FY2025 earnings release.

items.name: Audited Consolidated Financial Statements
items.what_it_is: The company's audited annual financial statements including notes.
items.why_needed: To verify the accuracy of the earnings release figures.

items.name: Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A)
items.what_it_is: Narrative explanation of financial results, liquidity, capital resources, and known trends or uncertainties.
items.why_needed: Needed to understand drivers behind performance and future risks beyond the press release highlights.

items.name: Independent Auditor’s Report
items.what_it_is: The independent auditor’s report on the financial statements.
items.why_needed: To confirm that the statements are presented fairly in accordance with GAAP.

items.name: Credit Facility Agreement
items.what_it_is: Loan agreement governing the $62.5 million revolving credit facility.
items.why_needed: Release notes no drawdowns; need terms, covenants, and rates to assess liquidity risk.

sets.name: Small data room: contract, order and release
sets.engagement: SEC enforcement matter concerning Latch, Inc.'s revenue recognition practices

items.name: Offer of Settlement
items.what_it_is: The document submitted by Latch, Inc. to the SEC prior to the issuance of the cease‑and‑desist order.
items.why_needed: To understand the terms admitted, any concessions, and the basis for the Commission’s acceptance.
